value.rationale: The expectation of distinct scattered palindrome patterns for a correlated finite-state source is a natural random-string complexity invariant. The result quantifies source memory using an exact rational enumerator and asymptotic leading constant, and characterizes a strict transition-probability optimum across infinitely many source laws with identical one-letter marginals. These are not mere iid substitution or fixed-length table increments.
